# With --output-datastar, a TemplateRoute builds the Datastar action for its
# route: Datastar() starts the chain, ContentType, Selector, OpenWhenHidden and
# RequestCancellation set an option, and Action renders @verb(path, {options})
# as template.JS, which html/template writes as JavaScript into a data-on:*
# attribute. The options are a JSON object, which is also a JavaScript one.
# A route whose pattern names no method has no verb, so it fails the render.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server --output-datastar
muxt check

exec go test

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /{$} Index()"}}<button data-on:click="{{(.Path.Delete 7).Datastar.Action}}">x</button>{{end}}

{{define "GET /form Form()"}}<form data-on:submit="{{(((.Path.Create).Datastar.ContentType "form").Selector "#f").Action}}"></form>{{end}}

{{define "GET /options Options()"}}<a data-on:click="{{(((.Path.Create).Datastar.OpenWhenHidden true).RequestCancellation "disabled").Action}}">o</a>{{end}}

{{define "GET /quote Quote()"}}<a data-on:click="{{((.Path.Create).Datastar.Selector `a"b'c`).Action}}">q</a>{{end}}

{{define "GET /bad Bad()"}}<a data-on:click="{{.Path.Ping.Datastar.Action}}">bad</a>{{end}}

{{define "DELETE /items/{id} Delete(id)"}}{{end}}

{{define "POST /items Create()"}}{{end}}

{{define "/ping Ping()"}}{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string     { return "" }
func (Server) Form() string      { return "" }
func (Server) Options() string   { return "" }
func (Server) Quote() string     { return "" }
func (Server) Bad() string       { return "" }
func (Server) Delete(id int) int { return id }
func (Server) Create() string    { return "" }
func (Server) Ping() string      { return "" }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"html"
	"html/template"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func serve(t *testing.T, mux *http.ServeMux, target string) (int, string) {
	t.Helper()
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, target, nil))
	body, err := io.ReadAll(rec.Result().Body)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return rec.Code, string(body)
}

func TestRendered(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		target, want string
	}{
		{"/", `@delete("/items/7")`},
		{"/form", `@post("/items", {"contentType":"form","selector":"#f"})`},
		{"/options", `@post("/items", {"openWhenHidden":true,"requestCancellation":"disabled"})`},
		{"/quote", `@post("/items", {"selector":"a\"b'c"})`},
	} {
		code, body := serve(t, mux, tt.target)
		if code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(html.UnescapeString(body), tt.want) {
			t.Errorf("GET %s = %d %q, want 200 containing %q once HTML-unescaped", tt.target, code, body, tt.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestUnsupportedMethodFailsTheRender(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	if code, body := serve(t, mux, "/bad"); code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
		t.Errorf("GET /bad = %d %q, want 500", code, body)
	}
}

func TestActionInGo(t *testing.T) {
	got, err := TemplateRoutePaths{}.Create().Datastar().ContentType("form").Action()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if want := template.JS(`@post("/items", {"contentType":"form"})`); got != want {
		t.Errorf("Action() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if _, err := (TemplateRoutePaths{}).Ping().Datastar().Action(); err == nil {
		t.Error("Action() of a route without a method succeeded, want an error")
	}
}
